name: Keyside

categories.label: Harbour scoring tiles 1-12
categories.hint: Per tile: keyples in harbour x tile requirement (capped per keyple, usually 12). Sum all 12 tiles.

categories.label: Cottages and houses
categories.hint: Sum of points on cottages/houses on your player mat per their colour conditions.

categories.label: Gems
categories.hint: Per purple skill track level: 1 type = 1 pt, 2 types = 1 pt each, all gems = 1 pt each.

categories.label: Headlands E (Support) and F (Beach)
categories.hint: Beach: 2 pts per keyple in the 2 adjacent harbours. Support counts as an extra keyple on its harbour (include in the harbour tile points).

categories.label: Forest, quarry, wheat fields
categories.hint: 3 points for each of the three you own.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Start player marker counts as any one resource/animal/fish/gem for scoring. Harbour tiles are randomised/double-sided so harbour points are entered as a total. Solo (Keytoma) mode not modelled. Sourced from RulesPal rulebook text of the official rules, not the PDF itself.
